verdict.rationale: A direct probe got HTTP 200 for https://metorial.com/openapi.json, and the response contains an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec can be downloaded at a well-known path. Corroborating probes show a live, key-gated public REST API with machine-readable errors, and an llms.txt that indexes the API reference. Missing for 10: first-party docs that point to or describe the OpenAPI spec, and verification of the spec's coverage and version against the live REST API.
